title: Budget Annihilation Blueprint Schema
description: Canonical schema for blueprint and shot TypeScript/Rust type generation.

EmissionMediumTargetRoutes.description: The two exhaustively authored target-medium routes for one emission source medium.

EmissionMediumTrajectoryMatrix.description: Exhaustive source-medium x target-medium delivery routes. All four booleans are explicit; no route is inferred and true routes have no preference ordering.

visionRadius.description: Full-identity vision radius. The host unit/building origin routes this scalar circle to the team air-vision or water-vision field.

radarRadius.description: Anonymous contact radius. The host origin routes this scalar circle to team air-radar or water-radar; water radar is presented as sonar.

detectorRadius.description: Cloak detection reach inside the host-selected vision field. Detection does not locate by itself.

jammingRadius.description: Denies enemy radar in the host origin's medium. The same scalar produces air-radar jamming above water and water-radar/sonar jamming below water; direct vision remains unaffected. This local tactical field is capped at 1200 world units.

SensorCapabilityConfig.description: One scalar sensor suite. The host unit/building origin alone selects air (origin at or above the waterline) or water (origin below it), and routes visionRadius, radarRadius, and jammingRadius to exactly that medium's team fields. Mounted sensor height and target medium never select a matrix cell. detectorRadius reveals cloak only inside the selected vision lane.

ShotTurningBlueprint.description: Blueprint-owned guided turning controls. turnRate is radians per second and guidanceSolveRateHz controls expensive intercept refreshes, not per-tick steering.

EntitySignature.description: How this entity appears to enemy CONTACT sensors. Stealth suppresses the blip, never the eyeball: a stealthed unit standing in an enemy's line of sight is seen normally. That asymmetry is the whole point — stealth buys you approach, not immunity.

LegFootSphere.description: The outward-biased gait sphere for one leg. originExtensionRatio offsets its center from the attachment; radiusLegLengthRatio controls how far the planted foot may wander before snapping. Mechanical reach remains derived from the two segment lengths.

shoulder.description: Left shoulder socket in unit-radius ratios; the right arm mirrors it.

radius.description: Arm segment thickness in world units.

handRadiusRatio.description: Hand ball radius as a ratio of the arm radius.

restSwingDeg.description: Shoulder pitch held while standing still, degrees; positive swings the hand forward.

walkSwingDeg.description: Peak shoulder swing either side of rest at full stride, degrees.

outwardDeg.description: Constant outward roll of the arm away from the torso, degrees.

elbowBendDirection.description: Vertical two-link silhouette at the elbow. Downward makes the upper segment rise from the shoulder and the forearm turn back down; omitted pairs retain the ordinary hanging arm.

hip.description: Left hip socket in unit-radius ratios; the right leg mirrors it. The stopped foot may open farther outward from this socket.

radius.description: Thigh cross-section in world units; the shin and knee derive from it.

segments.description: Thigh and shin lengths as unit-radius ratios.

footLengthRatio.description: Sole length as a ratio of total leg length.

footWidthRatio.description: Sole width as a ratio of the leg radius.

strideLengthRatio.description: Nominal left/right step length as a ratio of total leg length. The bot renderer derives its full no-slip gait-cycle distance from this value.

strideLiftRatio.description: Peak foot lift during swing, as a ratio of leg length.

standHeightRatio.description: Hip height above the sole at a standstill, as a ratio of leg length. Below 1 leaves reach available for the forward/outward stopped stance.

stanceForwardUnitRadiusRatio.description: Forward offset of both feet from their hip sockets in the stopped standing pose, as a unit-radius ratio. It blends away into the walk cycle.

stanceOutwardUnitRadiusRatio.description: Additional lateral opening from each hip socket to its foot in the stopped standing pose, as a unit-radius ratio. It blends away into the walk cycle.

legs.description: The walking half. Its own rig — a mech leg is a hinge in one vertical plane, not an arachnid limb.

upperArms.description: Optional second weapon-arm pair. Turrets attach through leftUpperArm/rightUpperArm sockets and remain ordinary articulated bot-host stations.

upperBodyRestoreDelayMs.description: Delay after the last upper-body station claim before the torso returns toward lower-body forward, in milliseconds.

surfaceFollowingInverseForceFromGround.description: Inverse-distance support-force coefficient sourced from the probe-averaged distance to the highest solid ground/support surface.

surfaceFollowingInverseForceFromWater.description: Inverse-distance support-force coefficient sourced from the probe-averaged distance to exposed water.

surfaceFollowingInverseForceFromGround.description: Inverse-distance support-force coefficient sourced from the probe-averaged distance to the lakebed or highest solid support surface.

surfaceFollowingProportionalForceFromWat.description: Upward-force coefficient per world unit of probe-averaged depth below the exposed water surface.

mounts.description: HALF the fan array: the unit's left side (+y) plus any duct standing on the centreline. Every off-centre mount grows its starboard mirror at render time, so a pair can never drift out of step by being edited on one flank only; a centreline duct stands alone, since mirroring it would stack a second fan on the first. Authoring a starboard (-y) duct by hand is a contract failure.

turnRateDegreesPerSecond.description: Optional per-unit override of the preset constant-rate yaw slew (deg/s). Lower = wider turning circle.
Optional per-unit override of the preset constant-rate yaw slew (deg/s). Lower = wider turning circle.

centerYFrac.description: Centre height. Defaults to yFrac, which seats the oval on the ground — the only placement it had, and the reason a stacked torso could not be authored out of ovals.
Centre height. Defaults to half the height, seating the box on the ground.
Mid-height of the rod. Defaults to radiusFrac, which rests it on the ground. Belongs to the centre+pitch authoring form; do not mix with startYFrac/endYFrac.

pitchRad.description: Tilt about the lateral axis, positive lifting the FORWARD end. Belongs to the centre+pitch authoring form; do not mix with startYFrac/endYFrac.

startYFrac.description: Height of the rod's FORWARD end (+X, the end nearer the nose). Authored together with endYFrac as an alternative to centerYFrac+pitchRad: tuning where a boom's two ends sit is the thing you actually want, whereas centre+pitch moves both ends whenever either number is touched. Tilting keeps the rod's own lengthFrac, so raising one end swings the rod rather than stretching it.

endYFrac.description: Height of the rod's REARWARD end (-X, the tail tip). See startYFrac; author both or neither.

TeamOrnamentFit.description: Where this unit's team-coloured body kit sits on its hull, as fractions of the body's own extents. The kit's SHAPE is one design shared by the whole roster (see TeamOrnament3D); these four numbers are the box it is fitted into, which is what stops a rail meant for a walker's carapace from hanging off the ends of a hull that is a different proportion. 1 means 'out to the body's own edge'.

backX.description: Rearmost rail point, as a fraction of the body's rear extent.

frontX.description: Foremost rail point, as a fraction of the body's front extent.

backY.description: Rail height at the tail, as a fraction of the body's top.

frontY.description: Rail height at the nose, as a fraction of the body's top.

requiresWater.description: Whether this unit is omitted from rosters on maps with no water. This is authored availability, not inferred from locomotion.

requiresLand.description: Whether this unit is omitted from rosters on maps with no land. This is authored availability, not inferred from locomotion.

supportPointOffsetZ.description: Vertical offset from the body center to its support point.
